---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a maintainer-facing evidence or policy improvement
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
---

## Maintainer problem

What recurring workflow or evidence problem should AEG solve?

## Evidence source

Which structured input, adapter, Git fact, or report field would be involved? Explain why existing inputs are insufficient.

## Policy and compatibility impact

Describe the affected profile, reason codes, adapters, exit codes, and compatibility risks. State whether the proposal changes the frozen v0.1 contract.

## Security and privacy impact

Explain how the proposal preserves read-only operation, zero runtime LLM/API/network access, no secrets, and no candidate execution.

## Acceptance criteria

List deterministic synthetic fixtures and negative cases that would demonstrate the feature without using private repository data.
